This small plot is my enset and a few coffee bushes near the house. I do not buy fertilizer from the cooperative for this one — the plot is too small and I have no cash to spare after feeding my children. I put the kitchen ash and the cattle manure here, like my mother did, and the enset grows well enough. I do not need to buy seed because enset I take from my own suckers, and the rains here are enough so I do not carry water to it.
